params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $env:OS='Windows_NT'; $env:CI='true'; $env:GITHUB_SHA='f924d42c68af06785286329a1e8ae92c7eff2d58'; $env:GITHUB_REF='refs/heads/main'; $env:MHW_UPDATE_SOURCE_SHA='f924d42c68af06785286329a1e8ae92c7eff2d58'; $env:MHW_UPDATE_BUILD_NUMBER='62'; powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File '.\scripts\Build-Release.ps1'; $build=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('BUILD_EXIT=' + $build); if($build -ne 0){exit $build}; powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File '.\scripts\Test-UpdaterReleasePolicy.ps1'; $policy=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('POLICY_EXIT=' + $policy); if($policy -ne 0){exit $policy}; $manifest=Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath '.\artifacts\update-manifest.json' | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Output ('MANIFEST_VERSION=' + $manifest.version); Write-Output ('MANIFEST_BUILD=' + $manifest.buildNumber); Write-Output ('MANIFEST_SOURCE=' + $manifest.sourceSha); Write-Output ('MANIFEST_ASSET=' + $manifest.assetName); $zip=Join-Path '.\artifacts' $manifest.assetName; $hash=(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $zip).Hash.ToLowerInvariant(); Write-Output ('ARTIFACT_SHA256=' + $hash); Write-Output ('ARTIFACT_BYTES=' + (Get-Item -LiteralPath $zip).Length); exit 0
